The '''breathers''' were a rare<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]]. [[Scientist/Legends|Scientists]] were unsure if this race was of an older evolutionary stock, destined to either die out or further evolve;<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> or if they were another coexisting race.<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> This subspecies possessed [[Lung/Legends|lungs]],<ref name="AE" /> along with the usual assortment of internal organs that were typical for most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SAV">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>

These Gands were adapted to breathing only [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] and, unlike the [[Non-breathing Gand/Legends|lungless]] variety, could not survive offworld without [[Breath mask/Legends|respiratory gear]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Oxygen/Legends|Oxygen]] exposure could burn the inside of the lungs like [[Acid/Legends|acid]],<ref name="AE" /> which would require organ transplants.<ref name="WDNTS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050120a|text=We Don't Need That Scum}}</ref> If a breather Gand were exposed to oxygen, that individual would display various respiratory symptoms, which included chest pain, shortness of breath, and coughing, which would bring up [[Blood/Legends|blood]].<ref name="OPF">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> Due to the unavailability of the necessary treatment to repair the damage, offworld Gands stricken with oxygen inhalation had a higher mortality rate.<ref name="AE" /> [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], a Gand [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], was a member of this subspecies,<ref name="OPF" /> as was his second-cousin [[Lu'daal-ud]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
